newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed on higher turnover.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on higher turnover on Wednesday, with food processor Podravka taking the spotlight.
* Five of 12 active issues rose, five were down, one was flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume up at 17,121 shares, turnover doubled to 10.5 million kuna.
* Top gainer hotelier Arenaturist gained 10 kuna to 170, with 58 shares sold.
* Biggest loser hotelier Jadranturist dipped 18 kuna to 280 with 795 shares sold.
* Most active food processor Podravka edged up 16 kuna to reach its nominal value of 300 kuna on volume of 10,956 units. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
